# Provider catalog: one table of every agent CLI, used by the engine and graph-manager

## What to build

Create `packages/graph-execution/src/providers/catalog.ts`, a single table describing every supported agent CLI. Today seven are planned: claude, codex, opencode, qwen, pi, omp and copilot. Only the first four have engine adapters so far. Other tasks add the pi, omp and copilot adapters and graph-manager agents; **this task adds all seven catalog entries, but adapters only stay for the existing four**.

Export the catalog from `graph-execution/api`. Make every hardcoded provider list in the engine and in graph-manager's **server** derive from it. The graph-manager **web** bundle cannot import `graph-execution/api` (it pulls in Node modules), so the web keeps its own lists, and a server-side test asserts they match the catalog.

**Important: the CLI must keep accepting only providers that have an adapter.** Add `engine: boolean` to each entry: `true` for claude, codex, opencode and qwen; `false` for pi, omp and copilot for now. Each adapter task flips its entry to `true`. `PROVIDERS` in cli.ts = catalog ids with `engine: true`.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `packages/graph-execution/src/providers/index.ts` (L1-80): `getProvider` switch, `findOnPath`, `requireOnPath`.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/cli.ts`:
  - L26-29:
    ```ts
    export const PROVIDERS = ["claude","codex","opencode","qwen"] as const;
    const ALL_PROVIDERS = [...PROVIDERS, "fake"] as const;
    export type ProviderName = ...
    ```
  - `parseProvider` (L107-112).
  - Help text at L219 and L361 uses `PROVIDERS.join("|")`.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/review/reviewers.ts` L9-10: `export const REVIEWER_PROVIDERS = ["claude","codex","opencode","qwen","fake"] as const;`, used at L96 in `provider: z.enum(REVIEWER_PROVIDERS).optional()`. `z.enum` needs a non-empty tuple type, so cast: `[...ids, "fake"] as unknown as [string, ...string[]]`.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/api.ts` (31 lines): the public surface. Never import cli.ts there.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/api.test.ts` L21-28: checks exported names with `expect.arrayContaining([...])`. Add `"PROVIDER_CATALOG"` and `"PROVIDER_IDS"`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/sandbox-run.ts`:
  - L35-51 `LOGIN_FILES` / `LOGIN_KEYS` records. They are used only by `loginEntries(providers, home, env)` (L87-128).
  - L131-143 `PASSED`: the env allowlist passed into a sandbox container (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK, CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX, GIT_*, TZ, LANG`). **Bug to fix:** a login key that `loginEntries` accepts but that is not in `PASSED` never reaches the container. Make `PASSED` include the union of every catalog entry's `loginEnv`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/sandbox-image.ts`:
  - L34-44 `CLI_PACKAGES` and `cliDockerfile()`:
    ```ts
    export const CLI_PACKAGES = ["@anthropic-ai/claude-code", "@openai/codex", "@opencode/cli", "@qwen-code/qwen-code"];
    export function cliDockerfile(): string {
      return [
        "FROM node:24.22.1-bookworm-slim",
        `RUN npm install -g --prefix ${CLIS_TARGET} --no-audit --no-fund ${CLI_PACKAGES.join(" ")} \\`,
        ` && ${CLIS_TARGET}/bin/claude --version && ${CLIS_TARGET}/bin/codex --version`,
      ].join("\n");
    }
    ```
  - `sandbox-image.test.ts` L78-87 asserts the exact string. Derive `CLI_PACKAGES` from the catalog **in catalog order, all seven entries plus `bun`** (omp needs Bun at runtime). Update the test to the new string.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/terminals.ts`:
  - L98-113:
    ```ts
    const AGENT_SESSION_ENV = /^(CLAUDECODE$|CLAUDE_|CCR_|CODEX_SANDBOX|CODEX_THREAD_ID$|OPENCODE$|OPENCODE_SERVER|QWEN_CODE$)/;
    ```
  - `AGENT_KEPT_ENV` holds `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`, etc.
  - Used in `terminalEnv` L124-138: `if (v === undefined || (AGENT_SESSION_ENV.test(k) && !AGENT_KEPT_ENV.has(k))) continue;`.
  - Replace the regex with `PROVIDER_CATALOG.some((p) => p.sessionEnv.test(k))`. Keep `AGENT_KEPT_ENV`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/runs.ts` L15: `export const PROVIDERS = ["claude","codex","opencode","qwen","fake"] as const;`. It is used by `startBody` (L20), `routes/internal.ts` (L14, L136-137) and `tools/open-start-run.ts` (L5, L13).
- Web lists that must stay equal to the catalog (do not change their contents in this task beyond what the test needs):
  - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/types.ts` L36 `AgentId`
  - `web/pages/StartRunDrawer.tsx` L11-14 `PROVIDERS`
  - `web/agentRequests.tsx` L44 `AGENT_LABELS`
  - `web/pages/Terminals.tsx` L801-807 `FALLBACK_AGENTS`

## Catalog values (exact)

```ts
export type McpMode = "inject" | "project-config" | "user-config" | "extension";
export interface ProviderInfo {
  id: string; label: string; bin: string; npmPackage: string;
  /** True when the engine has an adapter (`--provider <id>` works). */
  engine: boolean;
  /** Relative to HOME; a trailing "/" is a folder. */
  loginFiles: readonly string[];
  /** Env keys that log the CLI in without files. */
  loginEnv: readonly string[];
  /** Env vars a running session of this CLI sets; stripped from graph-manager terminals. */
  sessionEnv: RegExp;
  /** User-level skill folders, relative to HOME. */
  userSkillDirs: readonly string[];
  /** Project-level skill folder, relative to the repo root. */
  projectSkillDir: string;
  mcp: McpMode;
}
```

| id | label | bin | npmPackage | loginFiles | loginEnv | sessionEnv | userSkillDirs | projectSkillDir | mcp |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| claude | Claude Code | claude | @anthropic-ai/claude-code | `.claude/.credentials.json`, `.claude.json` | ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN | `/^(CLAUDECODE$\|CLAUDE_\|CCR_)/` | `.claude/skills` | `.claude/skills` | inject |
| codex | Codex | codex | @openai/codex | `.codex/auth.json`, `.codex/config.toml` | OPENAI_API_KEY | `/^(CODEX_SANDBOX\|CODEX_THREAD_ID$)/` | `.agents/skills`, `.codex/skills` | `.agents/skills` | inject |
| opencode | OpenCode | opencode | @opencode/cli | `.local/share/opencode/auth.json`, `.config/opencode/` | OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY | `/^(OPENCODE$\|OPENCODE_SERVER)/` | `.agents/skills`, `.config/opencode/skills` | `.opencode/skills` | inject |
| qwen | Qwen Code | qwen | @qwen-code/qwen-code | `.qwen/oauth_creds.json`, `.qwen/settings.json` | OPENAI_API_KEY | `/^QWEN_CODE$/` | `.qwen/skills` | `.qwen/skills` | project-config |
| pi | pi | pi | @mariozechner/pi-coding-agent | `.pi/agent/auth.json`, `.pi/agent/models.json`, `.pi/agent/settings.json` | ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_OAUTH_TOKEN, OPENAI_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, XAI_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY, MISTRAL_API_KEY, DEEPSEEK_API_KEY | `/^PI_CODING_AGENT$/` | `.pi/agent/skills`, `.agents/skills` | `.pi/skills` | extension |
| omp | oh-my-pi | omp | @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent | `.omp/agent/agent.db`, `.omp/agent/config.yml`, `.omp/agent/models.yml` | same as pi + COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN | `/^(OMPCODE\|AGENT\|PI_SESSION_ID\|PI_SESSION_FILE\|PI_TOOL_CALL_ID)$/` | `.omp/agent/skills`, `.agents/skills` | `.omp/skills` | user-config |
| copilot | GitHub Copilot | copilot | @github/copilot | `.copilot/config.json`, `.copilot/settings.json` | COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN | `/^COPILOT_(CLI\|AGENT_SESSION_ID\|LOADER_PID\|CLI_PATH\|CLI_BINARY_VERSION\|CLI_RESOLVED_DIST_DIR)$/` | `.copilot/skills`, `.agents/skills` | `.github/skills` | inject |

(The `\|` above is a table escape; the real regexes use plain `|`.)

Also export:
- `PROVIDER_IDS` (all seven ids, in this order)
- `ENGINE_PROVIDER_IDS` (ids with `engine: true`)
- `providerInfo(id)` returning `ProviderInfo | undefined`
- `SANDBOX_CLI_PACKAGES` (= every npmPackage, then `"bun"`)
- `loginEnvKeys()` (the deduplicated union of all `loginEnv`)

Keep `catalog.ts` free of `node:` imports.

**GOTCHA:** `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN` and `COPILOT_HOME` must not match the copilot `sessionEnv`; the regex is anchored, so it is safe. `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` and `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` match claude's regex but stay kept, through `AGENT_KEPT_ENV`.

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `packages/graph-execution/src/providers/catalog.ts` and `catalog.test.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: The table and helpers above, with a JSDoc header explaining that adding an agent starts here.
- **TEST**: The ids are unique. Every entry with `engine: true` is accepted by `getProvider`: the fake CLIs are not on the PATH, so assert the error is the "not found on the PATH" one, not "not implemented". `sessionEnv` matches `PI_CODING_AGENT`, `OMPCODE`, `COPILOT_CLI` and `CLAUDECODE`, and does not match `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN`, `COPILOT_HOME` or `PATH`.

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/cli.ts`, `src/review/reviewers.ts`, `src/providers/index.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `PROVIDERS = ENGINE_PROVIDER_IDS` (typed `readonly string[]`; `ProviderName` becomes `string`, or a union derived from it). `ALL_PROVIDERS = [...PROVIDERS, "fake"]`. `REVIEWER_PROVIDERS = [...PROVIDER_IDS-with-engine, "fake"]`.
- **IMPLEMENT**: `getProvider` keeps its switch for the adapters. The `default:` message stays `provider "${name}" is not implemented yet`.
- **GOTCHA**: `cli.test.ts` L330-334 expects stderr to contain `"claude, codex, opencode, qwen"`; keep that order.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck -w graph-execution`

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/api.ts` and `api.test.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `export { PROVIDER_CATALOG, PROVIDER_IDS, ENGINE_PROVIDER_IDS, providerInfo, SANDBOX_CLI_PACKAGES, loginEnvKeys, type ProviderInfo, type McpMode } from "./providers/catalog.js";`

### UPDATE graph-manager server
- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `sandbox-run.ts`: `LOGIN_FILES` / `LOGIN_KEYS` are built from the catalog (keep the exported names and add `fake: []`). `PASSED` = the existing list ∪ `loginEnvKeys()`.
  - `sandbox-image.ts`: `CLI_PACKAGES = SANDBOX_CLI_PACKAGES`.
  - `terminals.ts`: the session-env check uses the catalog.
  - `routes/runs.ts`: `PROVIDERS = [...ENGINE_PROVIDER_IDS, "fake"]`. `z.enum` needs a cast to a non-empty tuple.
- **IMPLEMENT**: A test `apps/graph-manager/src/server/catalog-sync.test.ts` that imports `PROVIDER_CATALOG` from `graph-execution/api` and the web lists (`../web/pages/StartRunDrawer` `PROVIDERS`, `../web/agentRequests` labels; export `AGENT_LABELS` if needed, and `FALLBACK_AGENTS` from Terminals, exporting it if needed). It asserts:
  - the web `PROVIDERS` minus `fake` equal the engine ids;
  - every catalog id that graph-manager's `AGENTS` lists has the same label in `AGENT_LABELS`.

  Write the assertions so they pass now and keep checking when the agent tasks add entries: compare the web lists to the ids graph-manager supports today (`AGENTS` in server/agents.ts), not to all seven.
- **IMPLEMENT**: Fix the tests the change breaks:
  - `sandbox-image.test.ts` (exact Dockerfile).
  - `sandbox-run.test.ts`: add one case that a pi key `GEMINI_API_KEY` is passed into the container env.
  - `terminals.test.ts`: add `PI_CODING_AGENT`, `OMPCODE` and `COPILOT_CLI` to the stripped list, and `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN` to the kept list.
- **GOTCHA**: graph-manager resolves `graph-execution/api` to the engine's built `dist/`. Run `npm run build -w graph-execution` before graph-manager typecheck or tests (the root `npm run typecheck` does this).

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/README.md`
- **IMPLEMENT**: Add a short "Supported agents" table near Requirements (~L46): agent, `--provider` id, CLI, npm package. List only the engine providers. The adapter tasks add rows.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `import { PROVIDER_CATALOG } from "graph-execution/api"` works after a build; the catalog has 7 entries.
- [ ] `--provider pi` is still rejected ("must be one of: claude, codex, opencode, qwen"), because no adapter exists yet.
- [ ] The gm-sandbox-clis Dockerfile installs all 7 CLI packages and `bun`.
- [ ] A sandbox gets `GEMINI_API_KEY` and `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN` from the server env when set.
- [ ] A terminal does not inherit `PI_CODING_AGENT`, `OMPCODE` or `COPILOT_CLI`, but does inherit `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN`.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` pass.

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npm test -w graph-execution -- src/providers src/api.test.ts src/cli.test.ts
npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/sandbox-image.test.ts src/server/sandbox-run.test.ts src/server/terminals.test.ts src/server/catalog-sync.test.ts
```
